newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys May/Jun fuel oil at $123-$113 per tne.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys May/Jun fuel oil at $123-$113 per tne.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought at least two cargoes of low pour fuel oil at $123 and $113 per tonne respectively for May and June deliveries, a company official said on Thursday.
CPC bought the 0.5-percent sulphur cargo at $123 per tonne for May 16-30 delivery cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung, Taichung or Shen Ao.
The 1.0-percent sulphur cargo was awarded at $113 per tonne for June 6-25 delivery to the same ports, c-and-f basis.
In CPC's last fuel oil tender, it bought 0.5-percent low-pour fuel oil at $131 per tonne and the high-pour at $121 per tonne for May deliveries, c-and-f Taiwan.
